recommendation_line: Δ54-55 dual-PMO product (exon-54 + exon-55 arms): validate naked, carry forward as anti-TfR1 Fab-PMO conjugates for cardiac coverage.
recommendation_text: Exon 55 is 190 bp (frame remainder 1), so single-exon skipping is non-productive; Δ54-55 is the minimal frame-restoring product (345 bp, -115 aa) with published PMO leads for both exons. TEST FIRST: no coordinated two-exon skip of this block has been quantified and both single-exon intermediates are out of frame.
why_this_design: Junction fuses R21 2580-2624 to R22 2740-2802: in-phase 108-aa hybrid repeat; cysteine-rich, WW, C-terminal and Dp71 intact.
3' endpoint sits inside the empirically mild exon ≤55 interval; smallest in-frame fix, fewest oligos.
One exon-54 AO reportedly co-skips 54+55: single-oligo upside, run as a probe arm, not the plan.
delivery: Left-ventricular exposure decides outcome and naked PMO barely reaches cardiomyocytes, so lead delivery is an anti-TfR1 conjugate; Dyne's DYNE-255 exon-55 Fab-PMO is IND-enabling, so sequence and tox package overlap and partnering beats rebuilding. Avidity/Novartis AOC benchmarks exposure but is not in-licensable. Naked dual PMO on a weekly brogidirsen-like schedule is the fallback and fastest IND, accepting skeletal-muscle-only benefit. Deprioritise cationic PPMO (hypomagnesaemia, eGFR decline, two clinical failures) and AAV9-U7 dual-cassette (non-redosable, non-titratable).

backups.one_sentence: Only option with in vivo rescue (Dmd Δ52-55 mouse: WT-like truncated dystrophin, normal sarcolemmal DGC, mild late deficit) and an exactly in-phase 103-aa hybrid repeat; cost is four simultaneous skips with out-of-frame intermediates.
Equally minimal and exon 56 is a natural multi-exon-skipping acceptor, but no human exon-56 ASO was retrieved, the junction breaks R21 helix C, and the endpoint crosses beyond exon 55.

critical_risk: Partial skipping is not partial benefit: unless both exons leave the same transcript there is no protein, only added NMD substrate. The 54+55 co-skip claim is one unquantified Discussion line; the closest systematic study found no single PMO skipping two exons, and exon 55 sits in the unfavourable 5'Fast-3'Fast intron class. Δ54-55 has no reported human carrier, so functional quality is inferred from repeat phasing. ESSENCE missed its functional endpoint: schedule a functional readout early and do not import brogidirsen, del-zota or z-rostudirsen dystrophin percentages as expectations.

experiment.payload_model: Myotubes from immortalised exon-55-nonsense DMD myoblasts plus an isogenic CRISPR exon-55 PTC knock-in comparator. Confirm in a second patient line before delivery work.
experiment.payload_constructs: Dose matrix: exon-54 arm alone (Ex54_Ac42 walk, 25-31mers), exon-55 arm alone (Ex55_Ac0/H55 nt 1-34), the pair at several ratios, and a connected-sequence molecule. Scrambled and untreated controls; nucleofection and free uptake, triplicate.
experiment.primary_readout: Long-read amplicon sequencing across exons 50-60 for product distribution (Δ54-55 vs single-exon, cryptic, intron-retained), junction RT-ddPCR, NMD ± translation inhibitor, C-terminal-antibody western. Sanger-verify the ACAGAAACCAAG|GACCTCCAAGGT junction.
experiment.success: Δ54-55 dominates skipped species, single-exon skips stay minor, no new cryptic or intron-retained species above background. Dose-dependent dystrophin of expected size in both lines.
experiment.kill: Single-exon intermediates dominate across the dose and ratio matrix, cryptic or intron-retained products appear, or no protein despite skipped transcript. Then switch to Δ52-55.
experiment.delivery_experiment: Conjugate validated arms to an anti-TfR1 Fab and dose IV in hDMD mice then NHP, measuring junction copies and dystrophin in left ventricle, diaphragm and quadriceps, with cardiac exposure as go/no-go.

precedents.entry: Single AO to human exon 54 reportedly removed exons 54+55 — the only coordinated-skip signal here; unquantified, so a probe arm.
Exons 56+57 and 58+59 double skips each needed one PPMO per exon; no single PMO skipped two — budget two oligos.
Out-of-phase spectrin junctions: DCM at 26 y vs 36 y in-phase, exon 50-55 deletions 43 y; selects the in-phase hybrid.
DYNE-255, exon-55 Fab-PMO with in vitro skipping, is IND-enabling: partner for sequence plus cardiac-capable delivery.
Brogidirsen: one product, two antisense sequences, 24.47% dystrophin at 80 mg/kg, 5-year safety — regulatory precedent.

lead.therapeutic_product: NMD-stable DMD mRNA lacking exons 54 and 55 (deletes aa 2625-2739): BMD-like dystrophin with cysteine-rich, WW and C-terminal domains intact.
lead.aso_design: Two PMO arms (exon-54 acceptor Ex54_Ac42 series; exon-55 5' end Ex55_Ac0/H55 nt 1-34) as one two-sequence product; connected-sequence molecule and exon-54-only co-skip oligo as parallel oligo-reduction arms.
lead.delivery_strategy: Naked dual PMO for payload validation and first-in-human optionality; anti-TfR1 Fab-PMO conjugate (partner or licence) for registrational cardiac, diaphragm and regenerating-fibre delivery.
lead.reason_it_wins: Fewest oligos of any in-frame option, best-anchored junction structure, published sequences for both arms, existing exon-55 conjugate package to partner.
lead.dominant_risk: Coordinate penetrance: unless both exons leave the same transcript, the product is out of frame and no protein appears.

all_candidates.reason: Smallest in-frame fix (-115 aa), in-phase 108-aa hybrid repeat, 3' endpoint inside the exon ≤55 mild zone, published ASOs for both exons, only reported coordinated-skip signal in the region.
Only product with in vivo rescue (Δ52-55 mouse: WT-like dystrophin, normal DGC, mild deficit at 52 weeks) and an exactly in-phase 103-aa hybrid; cost is four simultaneous skips.
Equally minimal and exon 56 is a natural MES acceptor, but no human exon-56 ASO retrieved, junction breaks R21 helix C, endpoint crosses beyond exon 55.

all_candidates.concept: Single exon-54 AO relying on 54+55 co-skip (1 oligo)
all_candidates.reason: Best possible outcome — one oligo, lead product — but evidence is one unquantified sentence; run as an arm of the lead experiment, never as the plan.

all_candidates.concept: Connected-sequence single molecule with arms in exons 54 and 55
all_candidates.reason: Brogidirsen proves a two-sequence oligo is a viable single product clinically and regulatorily, but both its arms sit inside one exon; cross-exon linkage is unprecedented.
Strongest human and clinical precedent via the 45-55 mild genotype and PBGENE-DMD, hinge-3 removal gives latest DCM onset, but 6-7 oligos is unjustifiable before 2-exon options are exhausted.
Oversized 126-aa out-of-phase chimeric repeat, no human equivalent, and includes exon 57, documented as unskippable without double targeting.
Six-exon penetrance problem with out-of-frame intermediates, unmeasured exon 56, hard exon 57, del58+59-class isoforms functionally inferior, outer-exon-only targeting reported to fail at this span.
Larger deletion and more oligos with no functional gain over the 2-exon products.
Mechanism-matched but regulators in both regions concluded effectiveness was not established; EU authorisation not renewed, US resubmission withdrawn Feb 2026.
SRP-5051 discontinued for prolonged hypomagnesaemia and eGFR decline; PGN-EDO51 stopped for insufficient dystrophin — uninvestable for a new exon.
Only architecture natively carrying two antisense sequences with durable one-shot expression, but non-redosable, non-titratable and high CMC cost for a first-in-class two-exon skip.
Most realistic independent delivery licensor with no exon-55 asset, but current human gain (+2.36% dystrophin) does not beat naked dual PMO; revisit on higher-dose data.
Muscle delivery shown for siRNA only, no nuclear splice-switching precedent and no DMD human data — architecture precedent, not a 2026-27 build option.
Reported ~30-fold potency gain on exon 51 in NHP is the right rescue lever if the 54/55 pair underperforms, but untested on this exon block.
